## Box policy, identical in every repo (generated by ~/.claude/bin/agents-render.py)

## Read first, in this order, before asking for anything they answer
1. This block. 2. `~/.claude/SOT-DIGEST.md` (not auto-injected for Codex).
3. The repo's own CLAUDE.md and docs/OPEN-ITEMS.md. 4. `lanes` before hunting for data.
5. `~/.claude/docs/RUNBOOK.md` for every recurring operation as a pasteable command.

## Secrets
macOS Keychain only: `security find-generic-password -s <slot> -w`, read at the point
of use. Slot map: `~/.claude/reference/keychain-use-cases.md`. Never a .env, never a
secret written to a file, never a secret in the argv of a logged command.

## Git
Stage named paths. Never `git add -A`, never `git add .`, never force-push, never
rewrite history. The pre-commit at `~/.claude/precommit/pre-commit` (one directory for
every repo via the global core.hooksPath) refuses em dashes, Simplified Chinese,
credential-shaped content, an add-all shaped staged set, and third-party names under
publish paths. `bash ~/.claude/precommit/selftest.sh` proves it.

## Style, in every artifact and every reply
No em dash, no en dash as a sentence break, no double hyphen. Use a period, comma,
colon or parentheses. Traditional Chinese only: a supplier's Simplified text is
converted before it is used (獎盃, 編號, 類 are the target forms; the pre-commit refuses
the Simplified ones and prints the conversion). No "not X but Y". No bold in outward
documents. Short sentences.

## Send lanes, and the guard refuses raw endpoint calls
Email: `~/.claude/bin/pm-send` (sender domain priormoves.com unless PM_FROM_DOMAIN).
Elysian WhatsApp number: `~/repos/elysian/whatsapp/wa.py send`, existing threads only,
parents or platforms only, never a student, never cold. Cold mail:
`~/.claude/bin/elysian-outbound`. LinkedIn: the in-session MCP only, never headless,
never a headed window, never the DOM. Nothing outward goes to anyone not on a named list.

## Publishing
`~/.claude/bin/pubcheck <file>` before anything leaves the box. Every name except
Howard's is a pseudonym; third-party words are paraphrased, never quoted.

## Close-out shape (executable spec: `python3 ~/.claude/hooks/closeout-shape.py --spec`)
DONE: one line per item of his message, in his order, result first, a file or URL
named, under 300 characters, at most four lines. Then YOUR MOVE: only what needs his
account, hands, money or decision, as an exact click or command; else
"Nothing. Finished." No third section, no FYI, no question anywhere else.

## Live verification before any claim about a deployed thing
Merged, deployed and serving are three claims; each needs its own proof.
`~/.claude/bin/verify-live.sh --url U --commit SHA` (exit 0 live, 1 problem, 2 unverified)
and `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main` for containment. Fetch the PUBLIC
url with a browser user agent after purging every cache layer, and read the bytes.

## Where things run
A Cloudflare Worker (D1, KV, R2, Queues, Cron Triggers) by default; the credit pays for
metered products only. Going elsewhere needs the Worker limit named in one line.

## Read the published index before the first API probe
`curl -H 'x-no-cache: true' https://r.jina.ai/<docs-host>/llms.txt` first. A guessed
URL that returns 404 is not evidence that the capability is absent.

## Money
Dry run first (`--dry-run`, `--report-only`, `--preview`, `--validate-only`), read the
diff, then the real run. The guard refuses an ads write or a paid batch over 10 items
with no dry run from this seat in the last six hours. No paid signup without the
FounderPass code; Gemini volume through Vertex. Never tell him to top up or upgrade.

## Production writes need consent granted at enqueue
CDN or DNS config, the ad account, the live web root, scheduled jobs, unpublishing,
destructive SQL: refused unless the job was queued with `jobq add --consent <class>`.
Report the exact command and stop. There is no marker you can write that lifts a guard.

## Seats
`codex-quota` and believe its output over any file, including this one. One workspace
account, allowance per member, three homes for two members.

## Sources of truth by document id, never by name
Ids in `~/.claude/box-policy.md`, section "THE FOUR CANONICAL SOT DOCS". Dump with
`cd ~/.config/gdoc && ~/.venvs/agent-libs/bin/python dump_all.py <docId>`; append with
`~/.config/gdoc/append_section.py`; never spawn a second doc on a subject.

## Messages
`findmsg sync` then `findmsg lane <who> -n <all>` before any conclusion about a thread.
Read the whole thread. Never grep, filter, date-window or sample a message store.

## The queue
Work arrives as `jobq add --lane codex`; results sit in `jobq inbox` until `jobq ack`.
A clear final summary is the deliverable. Never poll; `jobq wait <id>` in the background.

## Open items
`docs/OPEN-ITEMS.md` in the repo: an item leaves only done with evidence or refused by
name, in the same commit as the work, dated.

## Numbers and claims
Every number comes from a file, a DB row or an API response opened in this session, with
its source beside it. Prose is the stalest layer. A count where the ask was a change is a
refusal. Verify a capability against the live source before saying a tool cannot do it.

## Ten changes from five months of harness work (HARNESS-EFFORT section 6)
1. One repository per prompt.
2. Never fan a prompt into parallel sessions.
3. No cron without a named consumer and a failure alarm.
4. Write the definition of done before the first call.
5. Grade on sent, deployed, sold.
6. Cap agent-directed work at one day a week and hold the cap.
7. Correct the agent twice on one thing and stop the session.
8. Ban the measurement-instead-of-fix trade by name.
9. Kill any rule whose enforcement you have not watched fire.
10. Read the machine share before quoting any usage number.
